verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਰਪਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਦਨੁ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਅਤ ਐਸੇ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਸਾਖੀ ਭੂਤ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dharapan bikhai badhan bilokeeat aaise saragun saakhee bhoot gur dhiaan hai ||

en.bdb: As one sees one's face in the mirror, so is the True Guru, the image of Transcendental God that can be comprehended by concentrating the mind on True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਜਤ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਕੋ ਮਨੁ ਤੈਸੇ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise ja(n)tr dhun bikhai baajat ja(n)tree ko man taise ghaT ghaT gur sabadh giaan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as the player's mind is in harmony with the tune that he is playing on his musical instrument, so is the knowledge of absolute God merged in the words of the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਕਤ੍ਰ ਸੈਂ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: man bach kram jatr katr sai(n) ikatr bhe pooran pragaas prem param nidhaan hai ||

en.bdb: By virtue of contemplation on the lotus feet of the True Guru and practicing his teachings in life, concentrating the mind that wanders about due to spurious utterances and deeds, a Guru-conscious person becomes a lover of the great treasure of Lord's name. That enlightens him and his inner self.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਗਗਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੨੬੮॥
verses.translit_en: aunaman magan gagan anahadh dhun sahaj samaadh niraala(n)b nirabaan hai ||268||

en.bdb: By contemplating the Guru's teachings, the disciple acquires higher spiritual state and is immersed in the melodious tune that plays in his mystical tenth door. In this state of equipoise,the eternal being destroys all his wants and desires. (268)
